pending_part_2.voiceover_script: In Part 1, we explored the eerie midnight disappearance of a Mexican naval fortress... but when divers finally descended into the abyss, they discovered something terrifying. Declassified memos from the Mexican Navy reveal that divers found the missing stone bastion intact on the ocean floor, shifted over a mile away overnight without disturbing the delicate silt beneath. Even more chilling, sonar logs recorded rhythmic, metallic hammering echoing from deep inside the submerged stone rooms days after the collapse. Voice recordings from the recovery team were quietly scrubbed from public registries after divers reported hearing human breathing coming from unflooded compartments sealed for three hundred years. The government officially blamed an unprecedented underwater landslide, but structural engineers proved that explanation mathematically impossible. Something massive, unnatural, and completely unknown moved that fortress.
